fullContentHtml:
RSSB LDC Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Score Card 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the score card for the recruitment of Clerk Gr-II/ Junior posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 10,644 posts. Applications for the RSSB Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Recruitment 2026 were accepted from January 15, 2026, to February 13, 2026. The online examination was conducted on 05 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RSSB Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Score Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 January 2026
  • Last Date : 13 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 February 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 16 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 05 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 26 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 01 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 24 July 2026
  • Result : 28 September 2026
  • Score Card : 07 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EBC , OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

RSSB LDC Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Score Card 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
